name: Life Insurance Conversation Organizer
summary: Organize the obligations, time horizons, and ownership questions a life insurance conversation turns on.

spec.user: An individual or business owner preparing for a life insurance conversation.
inputData: Obligation categories and time horizons as bands
authoritativeSources: IRS published guidance on ownership and transfer-for-value concepts
spec.privacyBoundary: No medical information of any kind, no beneficiary names, no dates of birth, no financial account data. This tool refuses health input by design.
decisionRules: No needs figure is calculated. The tool organizes questions.
Nothing here is tax or estate advice.

This tool never states that a risk is eligible, ineligible, standard market, non-admitted, FAIR Plan eligible, bound, or uninsurable. It shows the published pathway criteria and names who actually decides, which is the insurer.
spec.uncertainty: Underwriting for life insurance is medical and financial, and neither is in scope for a public tool.
spec.output: A printable organizer of obligations, horizons, and ownership questions.
exportFormat: PDF via the browser print dialog
spec.schemaEligibility: WebApplication once built. Never medical schema.
spec.updateCadence: Reviewed at least every 180 days, and immediately when a cited source changes.
